gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: It isn't necessary to book in advance.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't have to' = it is not necessary.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.

gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: I'm sure we went the wrong way at the last junction.
gaps.hint: must have + participle for past deduction
gaps.explanation: A deduction about the past: 'must have taken'.
